fix(nix): Disable cargo libsecret integration

Its flakey integration tests made our CI break

fix(nix): Disable cargo libsecret integration

Its flakey integration tests made our CI break

fix(deps): update vulnerable transitive dependencies

Address audit findings:
- RUSTSEC-2026-0385: ctutils 0.4.3 -> 0.4.6
- RUSTSEC-2026-0391: zstd 0.14.2 -> 0.14.3
- RUSTSEC-2026-0398, RUSTSEC-2026-0403: zstd-safe 8.1.0 -> 8.2.0
- RUSTSEC-2026-0410: zstd-sys 2.1.1 -> 2.1.2

Regenerate cargo-vet exemptions for the updated versions.

fix(ci): make cargo-vet job work with cargo-vet 0.10.3

Build cargo-vet with stable instead of nightly; rustix 0.37.20 no longer compiles on recent nightlies. Pin cargo-vet to 0.10.3 and use the versioned memsec policy entry required by that release.
